comment: * EapSimAkaMethodStateMachine represents an abstract state machine for managing EAP-SIM and EAP-AKA * sessions. * * @see RFC 4186, Extensible Authentication * Protocol for Subscriber Identity Modules (EAP-SIM) * @see RFC 4187, Extensible Authentication * Protocol for Authentication and Key Agreement (EAP-AKA)

variables.comment: K_encr and K_aut lengths are 16 bytes (RFC 4186#7, RFC 4187#7)

variables.name: SESSION_KEY_LENGTH
variables.comment: Session Key lengths are 64 bytes (RFC 4186#7, RFC 4187#7)
